fields.title: Job search / detail record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of karir.com's own gateway2-beta.karir.com JSON API shape. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Full-detail records (search mode with fetchFullDetails=true, or detail mode) carry the complete upstream opportunity object verbatim (job_position, requirements, responsibilities, salary_lower/salary_upper, company{...}, ...). Search-mode records with fetchFullDetails=false carry only the compact search-result object (id, job_position, description [city], company_name, salary range, posted_at).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The keyword search or opportunity ID/URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-detail-api, S1-search-api, or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. not_found, invalid_input, disallowed_by_robots_txt).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

location.title: Location
location.description: Full-detail record -- e.g. a regency/city or province name.

description.title: Location (search summary)
description.description: Search-summary record only -- confusingly named by the upstream API, this holds the city/province, not job description text.

address.title: Address
address.description: Full-detail record -- the employer's street address for this posting.

job_type.title: Job type
job_type.description: Full-detail record -- e.g. employment type label.

salary_info.title: Salary label
salary_info.description: Upstream i18n label key, e.g. LABEL_COMPETITIVE_SALARY or LABEL_FULL_SALARY -- passed through raw, not translated.

salary_lower.title: Salary (lower, IDR)
salary_lower.description: Full-detail and search-summary records -- may be null if undisclosed.

salary_upper.title: Salary (upper, IDR)
salary_upper.description: Full-detail and search-summary records -- may be null if undisclosed.

degrees.title: Degrees
degrees.description: Full-detail record -- list of accepted education levels.

majors.title: Majors
majors.description: Full-detail record -- list of accepted fields of study.

job_levels.title: Job levels
job_levels.description: Full-detail record -- e.g. entry level / staff.

company_name.title: Company name
company_name.description: May be the literal upstream label "LABEL_COMPANY_CONFIDENTIAL" when the employer chose to stay anonymous -- not a login gate, just the employer's own choice.

company.title: Company
company.description: Full-detail record -- nested object: id, name, logo, industry_name, description, subscribers, benefits.

confidential.title: Confidential
confidential.description: Whether the employer chose to hide company identity.

is_urgent.title: Urgent
is_urgent.description: Whether the posting is flagged urgent by the employer.

posted_at.title: Posted at
posted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the job was posted.

opportunities_link.title: Job URL
opportunities_link.description: Full-detail record -- canonical karir.com URL for this posting.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across search-summary and full-detail records.
